'''Janet''' (Japanese: '''メグミ''' ''Megumi'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==History==
===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''===
Janet first appeared in ''[[AG013|All Things Bright and Beautifly!]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who entered the [[Rustboro City]] {{pkmn|Contest}} alongside her friend and rival, {{an|Chaz}}. She passed the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]] with a perfect score of 30 points and made it to the [[Contest Battle]]s. In the final round, she and her {{p|Beautifly}} defeated Chaz and his {{p|Venomoth}}, granting her one more [[Ribbon]].

{{an|May}} and [[Max]] assisted Janet during her Appeals Round by throwing plates while {{p|Beautifly}} used {{m|String Shot}} to break them. The experience and watching Janet's performaces inspired May to become a Pokémon Coordinator and to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} her very own {{TP|May|Beautifly}}.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[AG014|All in a Day's Wurmple]]''. She was also mentioned by May and {{an|Brock}} in ''[[AG016|The Winner by a Nosepass]]'' and ''[[AG035|Win, Lose or Drew!]]'', respectively. Janet was mentioned by May again in ''[[AG121|Hi Ho Silver Wind!]]'', who noted that they stayed in touch while traveling.

===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''===
Janet appeared again in ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}} and Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] battle on [[television]].
